notes.title: Son of a Gun Update 1.0.2: Smoother Gameplay and Key Fixes!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43788646/92adffa6c55234a4700b189213437a4bceb612db.png

Gear up, mercenaries! The latest update for Son of a Gun is here, bringing smoother rotations, optimized performance, and crucial fixes. Dive back into the action and experience the enhanced gameplay today!

Patch Notes:

 Player and enemies now rotate smoothly for a more fluid experience.
 Minor map adjustments to ensure fair and exciting battles.
 Various tweaks to improve overall performance.
 Shells and box debris will now despawn over time to keep the battlefield clear. (and improve performance!)
 Decreased the ghost kick force.
 Resolved camera jittering for a more stable view.

notes.title: 🎥 Son of a Gun - Release Date Announcement Trailer 🎥
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43788646/90e312f886110fc9dab728a6b873946a81e6f5c7.png
Lock and load, because Son of a Gun, the action-packed, top-down shooter is coming your way on October 11 (Nintendo Switch) and October 22 (Steam & GOG)!! Collect and manage your arsenal to wipe out hordes of jungle zombies, bugs, heavy robots, slimy monsters, and even space ghosts. 👾

Check it out!
[previewyoutube=9XM5wLIh7Oo;full][trailer][/previewyoutube]

Take the role of an interplanetary mercenary who can handle even the most overwhelming threats. Thanks to the hundreds of weapons at your disposal you can orchestrate your playstyle - Grenades, Shotguns, SMGs, Rifles, Plasma Guns, Sniper Rifles, and more - There is something for everyone to enjoy.


Your mission will not be easy - you will fight over 20 enemy types across multiple planets, each with a unique environment and challenges. And we hope you’re ready to fight with the gigantic bosses - be careful though, as they’re filled with surprises and unique mechanics!

Other features:

 There are plenty of guns in 7 different classes - pick your shooting style
 Use a time-bending device that will often save your ass
 Play as one of 6 space mercenaries
 Tactically push tactical explosive barrels to gain a tactical advantage
 Use environmental hazards to kill enemies
 Experience full of tropes, sci-fi story :)



Download the latest DEMO NOW!
